description: An opaque dark green fitted gown has a low square neckline, rolled or elbow-length sleeves, and gold-toned knotwork trim along the neckline, sleeve cuffs, front panels, waist, and floor-length skirt hem. Cream underdress fabric is visible in the center opening. Round ornamental shoulder brooches and a decorated belt accompany a green checked fringed wrap draped beside the arms. Brown shoes show beneath the hem.
